name: codejury
description: Run CodeJury's independent AI reviewers and judge, inspect saved findings, and continue review-and-fix workflows from your desktop.

interface.longDescription: Review pull requests with independent coding agents and a judge that investigates findings, applies fixes, and asks reviewers to check again. Set up the CLI, run or resume a review, and inspect saved findings and conversations. Desktop only: requires Node.js 20.10+, npm, Git, and separately installed and authenticated coding-agent CLIs. GitHub PRs also require GitHub CLI. This plugin uses CodeJury CLI 0.8.2-rc.1 (a release candidate), downloaded from npm on first use. Reviews can edit files and create commits; pushes are disabled unless requested. Code and prompts are processed by your selected agents and their providers, subject to their terms and usage charges. CodeJury keeps review records locally and operates no hosted review service. The included console screenshot shows a real prior review; results vary by repository and agent.
defaultPrompt: Set up CodeJury and check which coding agents I can use.
Review this pull request with CodeJury and keep fixes local.
Summarize the findings from my latest saved CodeJury review.

publication.release_notes: Initial desktop plugin with setup, review/resume, and saved-results skills. Uses the published CodeJury 0.8.2-rc.1 candidate.
